description: Cumulative change in the mass of the Greenland Ice Sheet each month from July 1971 to December 2023, from the IMBIE team's reconciliation of satellite surveys, with the one-sigma uncertainty. Negative values are a loss of ice.

origins.title: Mass balance of the Greenland and Antarctic ice sheets from the 1970s to 2023 (IMBIE 2026)

processing.description: Read the 'Cumulative mass balance anomaly (Gt)' column of imbie3_greenland_Gt_partitioned.csv (IMBIE version 1.0), 1971-07 to 2023-12, as printed.
Lower and upper are the value minus and plus the file's 'Cumulative mass balance anomaly uncertainty (Gt)', which the file states is one standard deviation (exact decimal arithmetic).

scope.baseline: Zero just before July 1971, the start of IMBIE's Greenland record; the first month's value is that month's change.
scope.basis: Reconciled from 24 independent satellite estimates (altimetry, gravimetry and the input-output method) by IMBIE 2026; total mass balance, the sum of surface mass balance and ice dynamics.

title: Greenland Ice Sheet mass change since July 1971 (IMBIE)
